caption: The drawing features a rectangular brass drawer pull plate with an octagonal border, rendered in shades of yellow and gold with black detailing to indicate shadows and depth. The central area of the plate is decorated with an engraved eagle, shown with wings partially spread and standing on a branch or arrows, with a shield on its chest. On the left and right sides of the plate, there are circular designs that function as the mounts for the pull handle, although the handle itself is not depicted. To the right of the plate, a side profile view is included, showing the thickness and raised relief details of the metalwork. The drawing is set against a beige background with a thin rectangular border. In the bottom left corner, a scale in inches is depicted, and the name "JANET RIZA" appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Drawer Pull
